# VectorCanvas

**Class:** `UltraCanvasVectorCanvas` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVectorCanvas.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVectorCanvas.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasVectorCanvas.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

**Edit** a vector drawing: page, rulers, guides, grid, snapping, selection handles, tool hooks in document coordinates (the model is `VectorStorage::VectorDocument`, the editing layer `DataFormats/UltraCanvasVectorEdit.h`, the node model `UltraCanvasBezierPath.h`)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasVectorCanvas](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasVectorCanvas.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasVectorCanvas> CreateVectorCanvas(const std::string& id = "VectorCanvas");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasVectorCanvas> CreateVectorCanvas( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UCElementDescriptor MakeVectorCanvasDescriptor();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasVectorCanvas(const std::string& elemId = "VectorCanvas");
UltraCanvasVectorCanvas(const std::string& elemId, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onToolPress` | `std::function<void(const VectorPointerEvent&)> onToolPress` | _Tool press_ |
| `onToolDrag` | `std::function<void(const VectorPointerEvent&)> onToolDrag` | _Tool drag_ |
| `onToolRelease` | `std::function<void(const VectorPointerEvent&)> onToolRelease` | _Tool release_ |
| `onToolHover` | `std::function<void(const VectorPointerEvent&)> onToolHover` | _Tool hover_ |
| `onToolDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const VectorPointerEvent&)> onToolDoubleClick` | _Tool double click_ |
| `onToolKey` | `std::function<bool(const UCEvent&)> onToolKey` | _Tool key_ |
| `onDrawOverlay` | `std::function<void(IRenderContext*, const VectorViewTransform&)> onDrawOverlay` | Draw tool previews in VIEW coordinates after the document and the selection handles, before the rulers. |
| `onViewChanged` | `std::function<void()> onViewChanged` | _View changed_ |
| `onHandleModeChanged` | `std::function<void(VectorHandleMode)> onHandleModeChanged` | The handles switched between scale and rotate. |
| `onRotationCenterChanged` | `std::function<void()> onRotationCenterChanged` | The rotation centre was moved, or dropped with the selection. |
| `onGuidesChanged` | `std::function<void()> onGuidesChanged` | _Guides changed_ |
| `onFilesDropped` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>&)> onFilesDropped` | _Files dropped_ |

### enum `VectorHandle`

The selection's handles, as the selector tool asks about them.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoHandle` |  |
| `TopLeft` |  |
| `Top` |  |
| `TopRight` |  |
| `Right` |  |
| `BottomRight` |  |
| `Bottom` |  |
| `BottomLeft` |  |
| `Left` | scale (or rotate / skew in rotate mode) |
| `Center` | the rotation centre |
| `Rotation` | the rotation handle (rotate mode) |
| `Body` | inside the bounds, on no handle |

### enum `VectorHandleMode`

Xara's two-state selector: one click shows scale handles, a second click on the selection shows rotate (corners) and skew (edges) handles.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Scale` |  |
| `Rotate` |  |

### enum `VectorRotationHandleStyle`

How rotate mode shows the rotation handle, which starts at the rotation centre and points the way the selection is turned (up for 0 degrees): Dial - a ring of degree ticks around the centre, with a wedge from 0 to the angle and the knob on the ring; Stem - a line from the centre to a knob just beyond the frame.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Dial` |  |
| `Stem` |  |

### struct `MeasuredFrame`

The selection's bounds and frame, measured once for a paint or a hit test instead of once per handle (a long line takes a while): while a FrameMeasure lives, SelectionBounds and SelectionFrame return these.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `bounds` | `Rect2Dd bounds` |  |
| `frame` | `std::array<Point2Dd, 4> frame` |  |
